intent: Create an evidence-bound visual study of Chronica for the contracted deliverable.

subject.identityLock: Keeps character, timeline, and consequence coherent across stories. Core instrument: A ring-bound timeline. Silhouette: A ring-bound mechanical timeline whose event plates connect to visible downstream consequence loops; no floating clocks or nostalgic scrolls. Materials: Inked linen strips, oxidized silver rings, archival paper, and dark wood registration blocks worn by handling. Spatial rhythm: Linear time crossed by sparse causal loops; clear before-and-after reading direction. Visualize a public product identity and operational instrument, not a mythological deity, generic robot, humanoid mascot, or autonomous authority.
subject.allowedVariation: Camera, scale, and surrounding evidence objects may vary; instrument silhouette, counts, joints, material system, working behavior, and spatial rhythm may not drift.

storyBeat: Chronica moves one corrected event plate and the downstream rings realign, revealing exactly which later claims must change.
composition: 4:5 vertical field portrait, full silhouette readable, one foreground evidence object, generous negative space for a future dossier caption outside the image.

output.cropSafety: Protect the complete subject silhouette, hands or countable limbs, and decisive evidence object from edge loss; no alternate crop is authorized by this contract.

designSystem.colorLaw: 70% ecological/material neutral, 20% identity family, 8% active phenomenon, 2% relational accent.
designSystem.escalation: resonant: one localized impossible behavior; environment remains physically legible
designSystem.materialLaw: Tactile, specific materials with wear, weight, construction, and local environmental response.
designSystem.typography: No text, letters, logos, watermarks, borders, captions, or pseudo-glyphs inside the generated image.

light: A warm archival beam follows one changed event into three later consequences; the rest stays quietly legible.

references.imageReferencePolicy: Use only owned or licensed references. Record file hash and role: identity, composition, material, or lighting. Never use a reference as permission to imitate its creator.

constraints: instrument geometry, joints, apertures, counts, and material connections remain coherent
visible phenomenon serves one story law
adult premium editorial finish; no mascot energy
instrument remains recognizable as A ring-bound timeline
spatial rhythm: Linear time crossed by sparse causal loops; clear before-and-after reading direction.
function is legible through material action without generated labels
public product identity, never mythology or autonomous authority
avoid: permanent flame crystal or waterfall hair
appropriated sacred clothing symbols gestures or shrine architecture
color as the only identity signal
matching humanoid uniforms across the agent team

deterministicChecks: declared aspect ratio within 1.5% provider-rounding tolerance
